body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館人名權威檔記載穆罕默德·納迪爾·沙阿生於1883年，並稱他自1929年10月起任阿富汗國王。美國國會圖書館法律圖書館的阿富汗國別研究寫道，被稱為水夫之子的叛亂領袖巴恰·薩考，在1929年1月17日至10月13日期間統治阿富汗，最後被納迪爾汗擊敗；納迪爾與阿富汗兩個王室都有親戚關係。該研究又說，1929年納迪爾汗掌權，國民大會確認了他統治阿富汗、作為穆沙希班王朝創建者的權利。
body.en: The German National Library authority record gives Mohammad Nadir Shah's birth as 1883 and describes him as King of Afghanistan from October 1929. The Law Library of Congress country study says that the rebel leader known as the son of a water-bearer, Bacha-i Saqao, ruled the country from 17 January to 13 October 1929, when he was defeated by Nadir Khan, who was related to both Afghan royal dynasties. It adds that Nadir Khan came to power in 1929 and that the Grand National Assembly ratified his right to rule as founder of the Mushiban dynasty.

heading.en: Concessions to religion and the 1931 constitution

body.zh-Hant: 美國國會圖書館法律圖書館的研究指出，納迪爾汗扭轉了現代化路線：他否定阿曼努拉以世俗主義為基礎的正當性理論，對宗教界讓步，並恢復伊斯蘭法。1931年10月31日，他頒布了《阿富汗政府基本法》；這部憲法大體以1923年憲法為本，並參照土耳其、伊朗與法國的憲法。憲法雖把權力分配給各政府機關，實際權力仍留在王室手中；民法與刑法也再度完全以伊斯蘭法為基礎。
body.en: The Law Library of Congress study says Nadir Khan reversed the course of modernization: he rejected Amanullah's secularist theory of legitimacy, made concessions to the religious authorities and reinstated Islamic laws. On 31 October 1931 he promulgated the Fundamental Laws of the Government of Afghanistan, a constitution mostly based on the 1923 Constitution and patterned after the Turkish, Iranian and French constitutions. Although it allocated authority to various offices, actual power remained with the royal family, and civil and criminal law were again based wholly on Islamic law.

body.zh-Hant: 美國國會圖書館法律圖書館的研究記載，納迪爾於1933年11月8日遇刺；德國國家圖書館權威檔則把他的死亡地記為喀布爾。他的獨子、法定繼承人查希爾·沙阿當時十九歲，登上王位，但實權落在三位叔父手中，其中穆罕默德·哈希姆汗以首相身分掌握了國家事務的全面控制。
body.en: The Law Library of Congress study records that Nadir was assassinated on 8 November 1933, and the German National Library authority record gives Kabul as his place of death. His only son and heir apparent, Zahir Shah, ascended the throne at nineteen, but real power lay in the hands of three paternal uncles, among whom Muhammed Hashim Khan, as Prime Minister, assumed complete control of the country's affairs.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、學業與克羅埃西亞權利黨
heading.en: Origins, studies and the Croatian Rights Party

body.zh-Hant: 克羅埃西亞雅塞諾瓦茨紀念區官方網站把安特·帕韋利奇記為1889年生於科尼茨附近的布拉迪納、1959年卒於馬德里的律師與政治人物。他進入札格雷布法學院，1914年畢業，1915年取得法學博士。自1918年起，他是克羅埃西亞權利黨（HSP）領導層的成員；他也當選札格雷布市議會議員，並代表該黨與塞爾維亞激進黨領袖尼古拉·帕希奇接觸。
body.en: The official website of the Jasenovac Memorial Site describes Ante Pavelić as a lawyer and politician, born in 1889 at Bradina near Konjic and died in Madrid in 1959. He was admitted to the Faculty of Law in Zagreb and graduated in 1914; in 1915 he was awarded a doctorate in law. From 1918 he was a member of the leadership of the Croatian Rights Party (HSP). He also became a member of the Zagreb City Council and, on behalf of the HSP, contacted the Serb radical leader Nikola Pašić.

heading.zh-Hant: 國民議會議員與主張獨立克羅埃西亞
heading.en: National Assembly deputy and the call for an independent Croatia

body.zh-Hant: 雅塞諾瓦茨紀念區網站寫道，自1927年起，他是克羅埃西亞集團（Croatian Bloc）在國民議會中的代表。1928年克羅埃西亞農民黨領袖遭暗殺後，他加入了農民民主聯盟的議員俱樂部。1928年下半年，他在權利黨週報《克羅埃西亞權利》上發表文章，主張建立獨立的克羅埃西亞國家，並與權利黨青年運動成員合作，嘗試成立名為「克羅埃西亞家園防衛」的組織。
body.en: According to the Jasenovac Memorial Site, from 1927 he was the representative of the Croatian Bloc in the National Assembly. After the leaders of the Croatian Peasants' Party were assassinated in 1928, he joined the representatives' club of the Peasant-Democrat Coalition. In the latter half of 1928 he wrote articles in the party's weekly Hrvatsko Pravo advocating an independent Croatian state, and worked with members of the Rights Party youth movement who were trying to set up an organisation called Croatian Home Defence.

heading.zh-Hant: 流亡、烏斯塔沙與馬賽暗殺
heading.en: Exile, the Ustasha and the Marseilles assassination

body.zh-Hant: 1929年1月6日王室專政法令公布後，帕韋利奇被迫流亡，先後到維也納、索菲亞與義大利。官方網站說他可能在1930年底於流亡中創立烏斯塔沙克羅埃西亞革命組織（UHRO），並在1933年自稱領袖（Poglavnik）。他參與1932年的韋萊比特起義，也參與1934年在法國馬賽刺殺亞歷山大國王的行動；事後他在都靈被捕入獄，1936年春獲釋，1937年義南條約簽訂後被拘於義大利錫耶納。
body.en: After the Royal Dictatorship Decree of 6 January 1929, Pavelić was forced to emigrate to Vienna, Sofia and Italy. The site says he probably started the Ustasha Croatian Revolutionary Organisation (UHRO) at the end of 1930, and that he declared himself leader (Poglavnik) in 1933. He took part in the Velebit Uprising of 1932 and in the 1934 assassination of King Aleksandar at Marseilles; he was then arrested and imprisoned in Turin and released in the spring of 1936, and after the 1937 Italian–Yugoslav entente he was interned in Siena.

heading.zh-Hant: 克羅埃西亞獨立國的領袖與流亡
heading.en: Leader of the Independent State of Croatia and flight

body.zh-Hant: 1941年4月10日克羅埃西亞獨立國成立，烏斯塔沙接管並組成新政府；帕韋利奇被宣布為領袖（Poglavnik），任命首屆政府，並自己擔任總統（至1943年9月）與外交部長。他簽署了《羅馬條約》。官方網站又說，他在1945年5月6日逃離札格雷布，經奧地利與義大利移居阿根廷，後逃往西班牙，1959年卒於當地。
body.en: On 10 April 1941 the Independent State of Croatia was established, the Ustashas took over and organised a new government; Pavelić was declared Poglavnik, appointed his first government and himself assumed the roles of President (up to September 1943) and Minister of Foreign Affairs. He was a signatory to the Treaty of Rome. The site adds that he fled Zagreb on 6 May 1945 and emigrated to Argentina via Austria and Italy, later fleeing to Spain, where he died in 1959.

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館人名權威檔記載，穆罕默德·禮薩·巴勒維生於1919年10月26日。美國國務院外交檔案所收的一份情報研究寫道，這位沙阿的父親禮薩汗將軍在1925年由議會宣布為沙阿。
body.en: The German National Library authority record gives Mohammad Reza Pahlavi's birth as 26 October 1919. An intelligence study reproduced in the State Department's Foreign Relations series says that the Shah's father, General Reza Khan, was proclaimed Shah by parliament in 1925.

citations.quote: The Shah’s father, General Reza Khan, was proclaimed Shah
by parliament in 1925

body.zh-Hant: 美國外交檔案所收的情報研究寫道，穆罕默德·禮薩·巴勒維在1941年、二十二歲時繼位，原因是他的父親在俄英入侵伊朗後被迫退位。研究說他一上任就面臨連經驗更豐富的領袖也難以應付的問題：外國占領、蕭條的經濟與失控的通貨膨脹。另一份1941年10月1日的國務院談話備忘錄記錄，伊朗公使認為英國強迫禮薩·沙阿退位是一個大錯。
body.en: A US intelligence study in the Foreign Relations series says Mohammad Reza Pahlavi assumed the throne in 1941, at the age of 22, when his father was forced to abdicate after the Russian-British invasion of Iran. It says he immediately faced problems that would have taxed even a more experienced leader: foreign occupation, a depressed economy and runaway inflation. A State Department memorandum of conversation dated 1 October 1941 records the Iranian Minister's opinion that the British had committed a great blunder in forcing Reza Shah's abdication.

heading.en: Meeting with Roosevelt at Tehran in 1943

body.zh-Hant: 1943年11月30日中午，美國總統羅斯福在德黑蘭與伊朗沙阿會面。外交檔案的編者按說明沒有找到這次會面的正式紀錄，大致可知主要議題是伊朗的經濟問題，以及美國協助解決這些問題的意願。12月1日，羅斯福致函沙阿，說昨天見到他十分高興，已收到他贈送的華麗地毯，並因未能多認識他、多看看伊朗而遺憾。
body.en: At noon on 30 November 1943 President Roosevelt met the Shah of Iran at Tehran. The editorial note in the Foreign Relations volume says no official minutes of the meeting have been found; apparently the principal subjects were Iran's economic problems and the desire of the United States to assist in solving them. On 1 December Roosevelt wrote to the Shah that he had been very pleased to see him the day before, that he had received the magnificent carpet the Shah gave him, and that he regretted not having had an opportunity to extend his acquaintance with the Shah and see more of Iran.
